brains.empty.note: Empty state of the list of Brains.

brains.local.zh-Hans: 这台电脑上的一个模型

brains.with_key.zh-Hans: 需要你自己密钥的服务

brains.used_by.note: Under a Brain: how many Imps use it.

servers.hop.about.en: Lets your devices find each other. It only passes encrypted data.
servers.hop.about.es: Permite que tus dispositivos se encuentren. Solo transmite datos cifrados.
servers.hop.about.zh-Hans: 让你的设备能够找到彼此，只转发加密数据。

servers.preset.imp_note.note: Note under the default servers choice.
servers.preset.imp_note.en: The default, run by the Imp project.
servers.preset.imp_note.zh-Hans: 默认选项，由 Imp 项目运营。

servers.preset.custom.note: Server choice: an address the user types.

servers.state_checking.note: State while a server is checked.

servers.state_ok.note: State of a server that answers.

servers.state_fail_local.note: A check of a server set to This computer found nothing answering there. {server} is The Hop.
servers.state_fail_local.en: {server} isn't running on this computer. Start it first.
servers.state_fail_local.es: {server} no se está ejecutando en este equipo. Inícialo primero.
servers.state_fail_local.zh-Hans: 此电脑上没有运行 {server}。请先启动它。

servers.state_fail.note: State of a server that does not answer.
servers.state_fail.en: Cannot reach it. Check the address.
servers.state_fail.es: No se puede conectar. Revisa la dirección.
servers.state_fail.zh-Hans: 无法连接上，请检查地址。

servers.hop.in_use.note: Shows which Hop is in use.
servers.hop.in_use.zh-Hans: 正在使用 {address} 上的 Hop

servers.hop.needed.note: Shown on a screen that needs The Hop when none is set.
servers.hop.needed.en: Linking from anywhere needs a Hop. Add one in Settings under Devices. Devices on the same network still find each other.
servers.hop.needed.es: Enlazar desde cualquier lugar necesita un Hop. Añade uno en Ajustes, en Dispositivos. Los dispositivos de la misma red se siguen encontrando.
servers.hop.needed.zh-Hans: 随时随地连接需要 Hop。请在“设置”的“设备”里添加。同一网络里的设备仍然可以找到彼此。

servers.off.note: Shown next to a server choice that is off.

animations.from_den.note: Heading of the animations you made or added.

voice.autoplay.note: Switch on the iPhone: voices in new replies.

voice.autoplay_note.en: A voice an Imp marks to play starts by itself in a new reply. Otherwise you tap it.
voice.autoplay_note.es: Una voz que un Imp marca para sonar empieza sola en una respuesta nueva. Si no, la tocas.
voice.autoplay_note.zh-Hans: Imp 标记为自动播放的语音会在新回复中自动开始。关闭后需要你点一下。

privacy.computer_note.en: Lets an Imp run commands on this computer when you ask.
privacy.computer_note.es: Deja que un Imp ejecute comandos en este equipo cuando se lo pides.
privacy.computer_note.zh-Hans: 你提出要求时，允许 Imp 在这台电脑上运行命令。

privacy.microphone_note.en: Used only when you talk to an Imp by voice.
privacy.microphone_note.es: Solo se usa cuando hablas con un Imp por voz.
privacy.microphone_note.zh-Hans: 只在你用语音和 Imp 交谈时使用。

privacy.trust_note.en: Only for your own devices. Their Imps may use tools on this one.
privacy.trust_note.es: Solo para tus propios dispositivos. Sus Imps pueden usar herramientas de este.
privacy.trust_note.zh-Hans: 仅限你自己的设备。它们的 Imp 可以使用这台设备上的工具。

app.login_note.en: Open Imp when you sign in.

app.system.note: Card title on the App page: login and language.

settings.group.sharing.note: Settings section: The Den, where Imps share things.

settings.app.control_ink.title.note: Setting: white or black text, icons and switches on coloured buttons and controls.

settings.app.control_ink.info.note: Help for the white or black choice.
settings.app.control_ink.info.en: Text, icons and switches on coloured buttons are white or black. A colour too light or too dark for them is shown a shade deeper or lighter.
settings.app.control_ink.info.es: El texto, los iconos y los interruptores sobre botones de color son blancos o negros. Un color demasiado claro u oscuro para ellos se muestra un tono más intenso o más claro.
settings.app.control_ink.info.zh-Hans: 彩色按钮上的文字、图标和开关显示为白色或黑色。颜色过浅或过深时，会显示为略深或略浅的色调。

settings.app.system.info.en: How the app starts and which language it speaks.
settings.app.system.info.es: Cómo arranca la app y en qué idioma habla.
settings.app.system.info.zh-Hans: 应用如何启动，以及使用哪种语言。

settings.backup.keep.info.en: Save your Imps and settings in a file, or load them back.
settings.backup.keep.info.es: Guarda tus Imps y ajustes en un archivo, o cárgalos de nuevo.
settings.backup.keep.info.zh-Hans: 把 Imp 和设置存进文件，或再次载入。

settings.backup.reset.info.en: Erase everything and begin again. This cannot be undone.
settings.backup.reset.info.es: Borra todo y empieza de nuevo. No se puede deshacer.
settings.backup.reset.info.zh-Hans: 清除一切并重新开始，此操作无法撤销。

settings.brains.services.info.en: The brains your Imps think with.
settings.brains.services.info.zh-Hans: 你的 Imp 用来思考的大脑。

settings.brains.keys.info.zh-Hans: 你的各个大脑所用的密钥口令。

settings.brains.keychain.info.en: Keep keys safe in your Mac's Keychain.
settings.brains.keychain.info.es: Guarda las claves en el Llavero de tu Mac.
settings.brains.keychain.info.zh-Hans: 把密钥安全放在 Mac 的钥匙串里。

settings.brains.requests.info.en: How patient an Imp is when a brain is slow.
settings.brains.requests.info.es: Qué tan paciente es un Imp cuando un cerebro tarda.
settings.brains.requests.info.zh-Hans: 大脑很慢时，Imp 有多大耐心。

settings.brains.retries.info.en: How many times to ask again if it fails.
settings.brains.retries.info.es: Cuántas veces volver a preguntar si falla.

settings.brains.first_wait.info.en: How long to wait before asking again.
settings.brains.first_wait.info.es: Cuánto esperar antes de preguntar otra vez.
settings.brains.first_wait.info.zh-Hans: 再次提问之前要等多长时间。

settings.brains.longer.info.en: How much longer each pause gets.
settings.brains.longer.info.es: Cuánto más larga es cada pausa.

settings.bubble.preview.label.en: Preview of the bubble on a light, a dark and a busy background
settings.bubble.preview.label.es: Vista previa de la burbuja sobre un fondo claro, uno oscuro y uno variado
settings.bubble.preview.label.zh-Hans: 气泡在浅色、深色和复杂背景上的预览

settings.bubble.media.info.en: What the bubble does with sound and video.
settings.bubble.media.info.es: Qué hace la burbuja con sonido y vídeo.
settings.bubble.media.info.zh-Hans: 气泡如何处理声音和视频。

settings.devices.link.info.en: Link another device so your Imps can visit it.
settings.devices.link.info.es: Vincula otro dispositivo para que tus Imps puedan visitarlo.
settings.devices.link.info.zh-Hans: 连接另一台设备，让你的 Imp 去做客。

settings.devices.mine.info.note: Help beside the Mine switch of a linked device: what turning it on allows, and when to leave it off.
settings.devices.mine.info.en: Turn on for a device that's yours. Its Imps can then message the Imps here, Imps answer it with their tools, it can open any Imp's files, and an Imp you throw to it goes without asking. Turn it on on both devices so Imps talk both ways. Leave it off for a friend's device: Imps still answer it, but without tools.
settings.devices.mine.info.es: Actívalo en un dispositivo que sea tuyo. Así sus Imps pueden escribir a los Imps de aquí, los Imps le responden con sus herramientas, puede abrir los archivos de cualquier Imp y un Imp que le lances va sin preguntar. Actívalo en los dos dispositivos para que los Imps hablen en ambos sentidos. Déjalo apagado en el de un amigo: los Imps le siguen respondiendo, pero sin herramientas.
settings.devices.mine.info.zh-Hans: 如果这台设备是你自己的，就打开它。这样它上面的 Imp 可以给这里的 Imp 发消息，Imp 回答它时会使用工具，它能打开任何 Imp 的文件，把 Imp 扔给它时也不会先询问。两台设备都打开，Imp 才能互相对话。朋友的设备请保持关闭：Imp 仍会回答它，但不使用工具。

settings.devices.mine.help.note: Hover help of the Mine switch of a linked device.
settings.devices.mine.help.en: On for your own devices, off for a friend's
settings.devices.mine.help.es: Activado en tus dispositivos, apagado en el de un amigo
settings.devices.mine.help.zh-Hans: 自己的设备打开，朋友的设备关闭

settings.devices.call_home.note: Help of the button on a linked device that takes back the Imps it holds.
settings.devices.call_home.zh-Hans: 把它上面的 Imp 叫回家

settings.privacy.core.info.en: What your Mac lets Imp do.
settings.privacy.core.info.es: Lo que tu Mac deja hacer a Imp.
settings.privacy.core.info.zh-Hans: 你的 Mac 允许 Imp 做的事。

settings.privacy.accessibility.info.en: So Imp can press keys and click for you.
settings.privacy.accessibility.info.es: Para que Imp pulse teclas y haga clic por ti.
settings.privacy.accessibility.info.zh-Hans: 让 Imp 能替你按键和点击。

settings.service.name.info.en: A name you pick for this brain.
settings.service.name.info.zh-Hans: 你给这个大脑取的名字。

settings.service.address.info.en: The web address of the brain.

settings.service.key.info.en: A secret password the brain asks for.
settings.service.key.info.es: Una contraseña secreta que pide el cerebro.
settings.service.key.info.zh-Hans: 这个大脑要求提供的密钥口令。

settings.service.cloud.info.en: A brain on the internet. It may ask for a key.
settings.service.cloud.info.es: Un cerebro en internet. Puede pedir una clave.
settings.service.cloud.info.zh-Hans: 互联网上的大脑。可能需要密钥。

settings.service.local.info.en: A brain that runs on this computer.
settings.service.local.info.es: Un cerebro que funciona en este equipo.
settings.service.local.info.zh-Hans: 一个在这台电脑上运行的大脑。

settings.tool.name.info.en: A name you pick for this tool.
settings.tool.name.info.zh-Hans: 你给这个工具取的名字。

settings.tool.address.info.en: The web address of the tool.
settings.tool.address.info.es: La dirección web de la herramienta.

settings.tool.command.info.en: The command that starts the tool.
settings.tool.command.info.es: El comando que inicia la herramienta.
settings.tool.command.info.zh-Hans: 用来启动这个工具的命令。

settings.tool.headers.info.en: Extra lines sent with each request, like a password.
settings.tool.headers.info.es: Líneas extra enviadas con cada petición, como una contraseña.
settings.tool.headers.info.zh-Hans: 随每个请求发送的额外内容，比如口令。

settings.tool.variables.info.en: Secret values the tool needs to run.
settings.tool.variables.info.es: Valores secretos que la herramienta necesita.
settings.tool.variables.info.zh-Hans: 这个工具运行时需要的秘密值。

settings.talking.between.info.en: How Imps talk to each other.
settings.talking.between.info.es: Cómo hablan los Imps entre sí.
settings.talking.between.info.zh-Hans: Imp 彼此之间如何交谈。

settings.talking.threads.info.en: Whether Imps keep chatting in the same chat or start a new one.
settings.talking.threads.info.es: Si los Imps siguen en el mismo chat o empiezan uno nuevo.
settings.talking.threads.info.zh-Hans: Imp 是继续同一个聊天，还是开新聊天。

settings.talking.window.info.en: How many minutes a chat stays the same chat.
settings.talking.window.info.es: Cuántos minutos sigue siendo el mismo chat.
settings.talking.window.info.zh-Hans: 同一个聊天能保持的时长，以分钟计。

app.window.title.note: Card on the App page: the smallest size of the app's window.

app.window.info.en: How big the window is. You can still drag its edges.
app.window.info.es: Qué tan grande es la ventana. Aun así puedes arrastrar sus bordes.
app.window.info.zh-Hans: 窗口有多大。你仍然可以拖动它的边缘。

app.window.size.note: Row: the size of the app's window.

app.window.full.note: Window size: as large as the screen.

animations.search.note: Placeholder of the search field on the Animations page.

animations.new.note: Button and sheet title: make a new animation of your own.

servers.state_unchecked.note: Under the address of a server that is set but was not checked yet.

servers.hop.off_note.note: Under Off on the Hop card.
servers.hop.off_note.en: Only devices on the same network find each other.
servers.hop.off_note.es: Solo se encuentran los dispositivos de la misma red.
servers.hop.off_note.zh-Hans: 只有同一网络中的设备能互相找到。

devices.show.note: Button and tab: show this Mac's code for another device to scan.

devices.scan.note: Button and tab: read another device's code with this Mac's camera, or paste its link.

sharing.browse.note: Button on the Sharing page: look through The Den.

devices.copy_link.help.note: Help of Copy Link in Link a device.
devices.copy_link.help.en: For a device that can't scan: paste the link in Scan code on the other device. Keep it private. It lets a device link with this Mac for a while.
devices.copy_link.help.es: Para un dispositivo que no puede escanear: pega el enlace en Escanear código en el otro dispositivo. Mantenlo en privado. Permite que un dispositivo se vincule con este Mac durante un rato.
devices.copy_link.help.zh-Hans: 适用于无法扫描的设备：在另一台设备的“扫描代码”中粘贴链接。请保密。它会在一段时间内允许设备与这台 Mac 关联。

settings.brains.wait.info.en: How long to wait for an answer before giving up.
settings.brains.wait.info.es: Cuánto esperar una respuesta antes de rendirse.
settings.brains.wait.info.zh-Hans: 放弃之前，最多等待回答多久。

settings.bubble.background.info.en: Whether the bubble is solid or lets what is behind it show through.
settings.bubble.background.info.es: Si la burbuja es opaca o deja ver lo que hay detrás.
settings.bubble.background.info.zh-Hans: 气泡是不透明的，还是能透出后面的内容。

settings.bubble.amount.info.en: How much of the desktop shows through the bubble.
settings.bubble.amount.info.es: Cuánto del escritorio se ve a través de la burbuja.
settings.bubble.amount.info.zh-Hans: 透过气泡能看到多少桌面。

settings.bubble.hide.info.en: How long a bubble stays after the Imp stops talking.
settings.bubble.hide.info.es: Cuánto se queda una burbuja después de que el Imp deja de hablar.
settings.bubble.hide.info.zh-Hans: Imp 说完话后，气泡会停留多久。

settings.bubble.lines.info.en: How many lines the text box grows to before it scrolls.
settings.bubble.lines.info.es: A cuántas líneas crece la caja de texto antes de desplazarse.
settings.bubble.lines.info.zh-Hans: 输入框增长到多少行后开始滚动。

settings.bubble.size.info.en: The size of the chat bubble. Drag its corner to change it.
settings.bubble.size.info.es: El tamaño de la burbuja del chat. Arrastra su esquina para cambiarlo.
settings.bubble.size.info.zh-Hans: 聊天气泡的大小。拖动它的角即可调整。

settings.bubble.autoplay.info.en: Plays a picture, video or sound in a reply as soon as it arrives.
settings.bubble.autoplay.info.es: Reproduce una imagen, un vídeo o un sonido de una respuesta en cuanto llega.
settings.bubble.autoplay.info.zh-Hans: 回复中的图片、视频或声音一到就自动播放。

settings.bubble.audio.info.en: What shows while a voice or sound plays.
settings.bubble.audio.info.es: Qué se muestra mientras suena una voz o un sonido.
settings.bubble.audio.info.zh-Hans: 播放声音时气泡里显示什么。

settings.talking.language.info.en: The language you speak to it. It listens in this one.
settings.talking.language.info.es: El idioma en que le hablas. Escucha en este.
settings.talking.language.info.zh-Hans: 你对它说话用的语言，它按此语言聆听。

settings.talking.talk_in.info.en: Which chat a message from one Imp to another lands in.
settings.talking.talk_in.info.es: En qué chat llega un mensaje de un Imp a otro.
settings.talking.talk_in.info.zh-Hans: 一个 Imp 发给另一个 Imp 的消息落在哪个聊天里。

devices.this_mac.note: Title of the card for this Mac on the Devices page.

devices.title.note: Title of the card listing the linked devices.

devices.empty.note: Empty state of the list of linked devices.

devices.this.info.note: Help on the This Mac card: the dot is The Hop.
devices.this.info.en: Link another device here. The dot shows whether The Hop lets devices find each other from anywhere.
devices.this.info.es: Vincula otro dispositivo aquí. El punto indica si The Hop permite que se encuentren desde cualquier lugar.
devices.this.info.zh-Hans: 在这里连接另一台设备。圆点表示 The Hop 是否让设备能从任何地方互相找到。

devices.list.info.en: Devices linked with this one. Mine lets a device act for you.
devices.list.info.es: Dispositivos vinculados con este. Mío permite que un dispositivo actúe por ti.
devices.list.info.zh-Hans: 与这台设备连接的设备。“我的”让设备可以代表你行事。

devices.reach.direct.note: Help on a linked device: reached on the local network.

devices.reach.server.note: Help on a linked device: reached through the server.

devices.reach.away.note: Help on a linked device: not reachable now.

sharing.gallery.note: Title of the card on Sharing with Browse and Import.

sharing.gallery.info.en: Find animations, triggers and Imps others shared, or bring in a kit you have. To share yours, use the share button on an Imp.
sharing.gallery.info.es: Encuentra animaciones, disparadores e Imps que otros compartieron, o importa un kit. Para compartir los tuyos, usa el botón de compartir de un Imp.
sharing.gallery.info.zh-Hans: 查找他人分享的动画、触发器和 Imp，或导入你的套件。要分享你的，请使用 Imp 上的分享按钮。

sharing.import.note: Button on the Sharing page: bring in a kit from a link or file.

servers.state_help.note: Help of the status dot of a server: its address and state.

settings.talking.waiting.info.en: Whether an Imp waits for the answer of the Imp it messages, or goes on and hears it later as a new turn.
settings.talking.waiting.info.es: Si un Imp espera la respuesta del Imp al que escribe, o sigue y la recibe después como un turno nuevo.
settings.talking.waiting.info.zh-Hans: Imp 给另一个 Imp 发消息后，是等对方回答，还是继续做事、之后再以新一轮收到回答。

settings.talking.waiting.wait.note: Option: the Imp waits for the answer.

settings.talking.waiting.dont_wait.note: Option: the Imp goes on without waiting for the answer.

settings.talking.waiting.decides.note: Option: the Imp chooses per message whether to wait.
